content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
The robot is now resting a short distance from the red ball. I think it's about 0.3 m away and roughly facing it, but I couldn't confirm that.

The ball wasn't in view at the start, so I walked forward and then scanned the room. I first saw it near the whiteboard stand and walked toward it. It dropped out of sight behind a desk and a chair and I had to relocate it. The final camera images show it by a desk leg and tangled cables, just below and slightly left of center. My last small turn to face it was cut short when `rest` interrupted it, so the heading may be a few degrees off.
